announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has dealt in the company's shares, which is a routine disclosure of personal trading activity. It provides limited insight into the company's operational performance but may signal individual confidence or lack thereof depending on the direction of the trade.

announcements.headline: Hardman & Co Research: 1H26 accelerating franchise growth
announcements.insight: This headline indicates a research report issued by an external third party rather than a direct corporate announcement from the company. Such reports generally provide independent analysis but do not constitute material information or operational updates for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Directorate Change
announcements.insight: Routine board-level restructuring typical of UK banking governance compliance rather than a strategic inflection point; lacks the signal of executive turnover or capital allocation shifts that drive ARBB's valuation multiples.
